method: Named conservative jurisdiction cores on Homann's Circulus Suevicus, bounded supplement to retained R1/R2 inventory. Five approximate native economic locators provide game-scale correspondence, not surveyed city accuracy.

polygons.territory: Habsburg Breisgau core around Freiburg; Baden Hochberg excluded
Conservative Habsburg Nellenburg core, not all Lake Constance
Temporal Habsburg town territory of Constance after 1548, distinct from the bishopric
Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen mainland core, distinct from Hechingen and Prussia
Haigerloch core, incorporated in the Sigmaringen branch by 1767
Imperial city of Ulm and conservative contiguous Albeck mainland; no annexation to Wurttemberg
Habsburg Burgau conservative mainland, not Bavarian until nineteenth century
Southern temporal Hochstift Augsburg core, not its whole diocese or independent city
Prince-abbey of Kempten conservative rural core; independent city and tiny enclaves not added automatically

limitations: No cadastral or two-pixel accuracy claim; Lindau mine is an independent approximate locator with a large mismatch, not a surveyed city. No physical locator is moved.
Map predates 1776. Historical continuity and reunions checked separately; Baden-Durlach and Baden-Baden stay one country after 1771.
Only explicit original parent masks may change. Previously split Mainz RGBs, Alpine and Italian layers, Rhine-Westphalia, Franconia, Belgium and Erfurt are protected.
Unidentified micro-enclaves remain abstracted without arbitrary territorial enlargement. Bishoprics denote temporal estates, not diocesan spiritual jurisdiction.
